Card Q&A.q: Can I use this card's [Main] effect to pay 2 cost even when I don't have any [Legend-Arms] trait or level 5 Digimon?

a: However, in such cases the "can't attack" effect prevents making the attack.
Card Q&A.q: Can I choose an opponent's Digimon with a "can't attack" effect as the target when I activate this card's [Main] effect?

a: At the start of your opponent's main phase, the effects gained from this card's effect are triggered at the same time, and your opponent determines which one activates first.

After effects such as [When Attacking] have activated, and before the counter timing occurs, it is time to activate the effect of the 2nd Digimon that was pending activation. However, since the 1st Digimon is already attacking, the effect ends without an attack made.
As a result, only the Digimon whose effect was activated first can attack.
Card Q&A.q: What happens if this card's [Main] effect activates twice and 2 of my opponent's Digimon gain the "[Start of Your Main Phase] This Digimon attacks" effect?

a: A Digimon with a "this Digimon isn't affected by your opponent’s effects" effect can also be chosen as a target for this effect, therefore your opponent's Digimon will lose the "this Digimon isn't affected by your opponent’s effects" effect as soon as it becomes your opponent's turn, then it will be affected by this card's effect.
As a result, the attack occurs at the start of the main phase.
